increment_paragraph: **CG22-CALLBACK-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS** (launched by the user 2026-11-17; gateway rule 4a amended in place, rule 13u's text corrected, Lean `QCore.CallbackCandidateScope`; [report](../../reports/cg22-callback-candidate-contracts/README.md)). Rule 4a's W4 derivation scope reached unselected internal-linkage definitions through direct calls only, so a header `static` comparator handed to `bsearch` or `qsort` (`rd_kafka_ApiVersion_key_cmp`, `rdkafka_proto.h:208`) was never summarised and rule 13u refused its invocation `callback-uncontracted`. The scope now also follows the designators a body names beside a call to a declaration with a synchronous invocation or a table dispatch, still only to internal-linkage definitions the unit carries; a summary is published only when it validates, and a candidate Unknown in its own unit (or one table member) keeps its caller refused. Census on the base (this card's own corpus preparation): 51 `callback-uncontracted` leaves / 49 functions / 18 decided alone over 46 candidates, 41 Unknown in their own unit (the cmetrics and ctraces decoder trees and five librdkafka callbacks), 4 external comparators Safe in another unit (rule 4c would admit them under the stated link map, which does not name them; the card pinned by test that the callback route already reads rule 4c's import and corrected 13u's text to say so), 1 header static. Measured by `quirin-audit measure --declared` (declared result match): corpus 1,082 / 6 / 3,616 -> 1,083 / 6 / 3,615, exactly `rd_kafka_ApiVersion_check` Unknown -> Safe, eleven rows changing content only, no Safe -> non-Safe, no Unsafe added; `callback-uncontracted` 50 / 48 / 17. System and slice not measured (corpus-only preparation).

The header-static part is DISCHARGED: gateway rule 4a's derivation scope now follows the designators a body hands a synchronous invocation or table dispatch (internal-linkage definitions only), so rd_kafka_ApiVersion_key_cmp is summarised and rd_kafka_ApiVersion_check moves Unknown -> Safe. The cross-unit part moves to CG22-CALLBACK-CANDIDATE-LINK-PREMISE (the callback route already reads rule 4c's import; the eight-home link map names none of the four external comparators). NARROWED: what remains here is the 41 candidates Unknown in their own unit (44 leaves / 43 functions / 17 decided alone): the cmetrics and ctraces decoder trees (36 leaves; every table holds at least one Unknown handler), rd_kafka_group_member_cmp, rd_qsort_r_trampoline, toppar_sort_by_list_cnt, rd_kafka_coord_rkb_monitor_cb (through rd_kafka_poll_cb) and rd_kafka_toppar_op_serve (through rd_kafka_q_serve and rd_kafka_op_req0). Many decoder handlers store what they decode into the context, so a body that comes to validate with such a store is still effectful under rule 13u. ledger.title: Four external comparators Safe in their home unit are not in force at their callers' invocations: the stated link map does not name them
ledger.text: Registered by CG22-CALLBACK-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS (corpus 66910c10 on the card's own preparation, tip c89aac4c9). rd_kafka_metadata_broker_cmp and rd_kafka_metadata_broker_internal_cmp (home librdkafka/rdkafka_metadata.c), rd_strcmp3 (librdkafka/rdstring.c) and rd_kafka_assignor_topic_cmp (librdkafka/rdkafka_assignor.c) are external definitions with Safe home rows; their callers' bsearch/qsort invocations refuse callback-uncontracted (6 leaves / 5 functions / 0 decided alone: rd_kafka_Node_new_from_brokers 2, ut_populate_internal_topic_metadata, rd_kafka_topic_assignment_state_rack_search, rd_kafka_partition_internal_find_rack, rd_kafka_roundrobin_assignor_assign_cb, each with another blocker). The callback route already admits rule 4c's import at a callback position (tests/callback_candidate_scope.rs, a_candidate_from_another_unit_is_in_force_only_under_its_import), so the gap is the premise: the eight-home link map (contract/evaluations/eight-home/link-map.json) does not list them. A variant map is in docs/reports/cg22-callback-candidate-contracts/artifacts/link-map.eleven-home.json, unmeasured. DISCHARGE: a decision to extend the stated link premise (a new or re-baselined evaluation profile, measured), or declared contracts for the four comparators read from their bodies and pinned; no status is predicted to move until the callers' other blockers are discharged.

AMENDED (CG22-CALLBACK-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS, corpus 66910c10 on the card's own preparation, base 32336c33d): class 1's bsearch decides no function alone any more: its one such function, rd_kafka_ApiVersion_check, is Safe once rule 4a's scope summarises the header comparator it hands bsearch (callback-uncontracted leaves naming bsearch 6 -> 5, qsort 3 unchanged). The remaining bsearch/qsort refusals wait on candidates Unknown in their unit (CG22-CALLBACK-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS) or on the link premise (CG22-CALLBACK-CANDIDATE-LINK-PREMISE).
